/etc/systemd/system/dell-service-directo.text:
[Unit]
Description=Service address directory
After=network-online.target dell-service-directory-firewall.service
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=dell-service-directory-firewall.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=120
StartLimitBurst=3
[Service]
Type=simple
User=servicedirectory
Group=servicedirectory
WorkingDirectory=/opt/dell/service-directory
UMask=0077
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/dell/service-directory/releases/d56cae553bf95ce0e2c3fe8f258a2f99389aae7c/server.py --bind 192.168.19.30 --port 9080 --catalog /opt/dell/service-directory/releases/d56cae553bf95ce0e2c3fe8f258a2f99389aae7c/services.json --http
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
MemoryMax=128M
CPUQuota=30%
TasksMax=32
LimitNOFILE=256
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
